headlines.text: House GOP chairs press Huang for a closed-door Nov. 18 briefing on his ties to an alleged Chinese spy tied to Nvidia customer Megaspeed
Huang apologizes to Nvidia staff and will stay on as CEO 'without interruption' while an independent board committee probes the matter
Dow and Nasdaq rally as falling oil prices offset a sharp Nvidia slide, with AMD and Broadcom surging in its place
Nvidia shares sink to their lowest since April, down as much as 8% intraday, as the board's Huang investigation rattles investors
Wall Street braces for Tuesday's October CPI report, the last major inflation reading before the Fed's December 9 rate decision
Fed held rates at 3.75%-4% in a 10-2 vote last month, with Cook and Hammack dissenting to push for an immediate hike, keeping December hike odds elevated
